attBesluta.text: This bench is sturdy, well made and looks good. I bought one for my porch and then bought 2 more to make a sitting area. I ordered a seat pad for it, too. The price is unbelievable! There are no comparable benches at that price point.
I love this bench a lot. I am using in front of my restaurant where people can sit and relax while walking. I see people and fully enjoying it.
I bought 2 and loved them so much that I bought another two. Now I am considering to buy more. They are absolutely beautiful, sturdy and won't be moved by any winds.
Nyligen inköpt. Snabb leverans. Enkel att montera. Mycket stabil. Jag hoppas den förblir lika fin efter att ha stått ute några år.

Excellent pour un prix très correct. Livraison faite très sérieusement. Paraît solide à voir dans le temps. Sera mis à l’extérieur près d’un bassin aquatique. Je recommande bon fournisseur et sérieux dans son suivi.
